oscar: Quick sync to finalize Atlas POC handoff. Need: success criteria, sanitized data path, SQ items, and short burst window. Target: 7 business days.

meera: Proposed checks: 1) p95 < 380ms on 512-token prompts, 2) overall relevance >= 83% on labelled eval, 3) no raw PII in outputs per automated redactor. We'll provide scoring harness.

customer-ops: We'll supply 4k rows (2.5k synthetic + 1.5k masked). Prefer to upload into our S3. Security prefers presigned uploads rather than cross-account roles.

netops: Two flows: presigned PUT to temp bucket (fastest) or cross-account read-only role for a single prefix. Presigned avoids IAM approvals and keeps timeline tight. Note: VPC peering adds weeks.

oscar: They attached SQ-6599 asking that data be redacted before transfer. Can SEs provide a minimal client-side redactor and a short checklist for their security team?

meera: Here's a compact POC redactor to run over CSV text fields:
```python
import re

def redact(s):
    s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\b\d{12,19}\b", "[REDACTED_NUMBER]", s)
    return s
```
Run locally and hold back a 15% blind set.

customer-ops: We'll run that and tag rows with a 'bucket' field for stratified reporting. We'll upload by Wed COB.

oscar: Pricing Q: They want a short 2-hour burst during load tests. Sales can offer a capped reserved node for the window plus alerts. Proposed: $350 setup + $120/day discounted reserved + per-token overage. Unused reserved days credited.

security-bot: Ticket SQ-6599-response created (TICKET-8120). Assigned to security@redwood. ETA 48h for first-pass.

meera: Action items:
- @customer-ops upload redacted CSV to presigned link when ready
- @meera share scoring harness + smoke tests by EOD
- @netops provide presigned flow details and optional IAM ARN
- @oscar draft POC SOW with spend cap and circulate
Reconvene Thu 10am PT to confirm ingest status. :thumbsup:
